passive.name: Cursed Touch
passive.description: Amumu's basic attacks Curse his enemies, causing them to take bonus true damage from incoming magic damage.

spells.name: Bandage Toss
spells.description: Amumu launches a bandage, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, Stunning them for second, and dealing magic damage. This Ability has 2 charges.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Despair
spells.description: Toggle: Amumu begins crying, dealing plus % max Health magic damage to nearby enemies every second and refreshing Curse.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalHealthDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Tantrum
spells.description: Passive: Amumu takes reduced physical damage. Additionally, when Amumu is hit by an Attack, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced by seconds. Active: Amumu throws a tantrum, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TantrumDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
spells.description: Amumu flares out his bandages, Stunning for seconds, dealing magic damage and applying Curse.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation RCalculatedDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
